source.problem: If the line that passes through the points $(2,7)$ and $(a, 3a)$ has a slope of 2, what is the value of $a$?
source.solution: Since the slope of the line through points $(2,7)$ and $(a, 3a)$ is 2, then $ rac{3a-7}{a-2}=2$. From this, $3a-7=2(a-2)$ and so $3a-7=2a-4$ which gives $a=3$.
